source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Using the inspection records, note the type of check that failed.
3. Note the specific element of the building that failed the check.
4. Review the building code applicable to the failed element.
5. Based on your review, specify the precise code requirement that was not met.
6. Note any potential causes for the failure.
7. Include the date the check failed.
8. Include any notes, photos, or sketches that illustrate the failure.
9. Review the documentation for clarity and completeness.
